Ana Sofía Sánchez Palau ( Latin American Spanish: [ana soˈfi.a ˈsantʃes] ; born 13 April 1994) is a Mexican tennis player. She began playing tennis at the age of 10, quickly developing a passion for the sport. [ 1 ] On 21 July 2025, she reached her best singles ranking of world No. 190. On 15 August 2016, she peaked at No. 221 in the WTA doubles rankings .
Sánchez has won 16 singles and 12 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . Her biggest title to date is the triumph at the W75 tournament in Olomouc, Czech Republic (July 2025). In 2012, Sánchez made her debut for the Mexico Fed Cup team . Career [ edit ] In August 2016, in doubles she reached the semifinal in Florianopolis , Brazil with partner Montserrat González . The pair lost to third-seeded Tímea Babos and Réka Luca Jani , in straight sets. She reached the second round at the 2018 Monterrey Open , her best result thus far, defeating Usue Maitane Arconada in the first round, before losing to Sachia Vickery .
